topic: Hanna's coefficient-congruence conjectures for OEIS A389474, A389475 and A389472
title: Hanna's OEIS A389474 FORMULA (3): a modulo-nine proof and companion congruences

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove Hanna's conjecture in OEIS A389474, FORMULA (3), and the companion conjectures in A389474, FORMULA (4), A389475, FORMULA (4.a), (4.b), and A389472, COMMENTS. For the first equation we establish A(x)^2 = x^2 + 2x^3 + 9Q(x), with Q in Z[[x]]. Integral coefficient constructions, Frobenius and binomial descent prove the six congruences. We also establish reversion identities and every even-power congruence modulo nine. If D is the A350432 series, every rational-seed solution of the A389472 equation is C_s=x+sD^2. Its product representation proves the stated convergence radius (sqrt(5)-1)/2 for D and every C_s with s nonzero.
summary: Proofs of six conjectures, reversion and iterated identities, the companion product, all-seed factorization C_s=x+sD^2 and the exact convergence radius, with coefficient checks for five OEIS series.
